defined_in: reports/ms/r4/pi_record/23_ms_r4_prompt.md, D6 (numeric parameters only); written before the launch, read by the analysis tools

bootstrap.resample: the 20 seeds of one q with replacement (indices rng.integers(0, n, size=(n_resamples, n)))
bootstrap.generator: a fresh numpy.random.default_rng(seed) per (q, statistic), in table order

gates.source: the pass flags of gates.json as written by the runner (thresholds of protocols/v2_T2_locked_v2_0.json)

e1.metric: stage2_peak_rel_err_abs of the frozen terminal stage, final tier

area.curve: final-tier eta_T_over_dw (= eta_2 / DW) evaluated offline on the stage-2 weight exports (tools/ms/r4_curves.py)

e2.gmax_metric: Gmax_full_over_dw of the final tier at the end of stage 1 (metric_values.gmax_final of gates.json)
